subject: business-model-ladder

validated_patterns.artificial_analysis: $417/seat/mo, codified 'providers cannot pay for results' independence. Closest structural twin — still unsigned/unanchored.
validated_patterns.defillama: Free data + $49/$300 tiers + enterprise licensing, stablecoin-native. $199/mo feed sits inside this proven band.
validated_patterns.fico: Per-measurement royalties ($0.50→$10/score). 2026 Senate monopoly-pricing probe = cautionary tale. Published fixed SKUs are integrity defense.
validated_patterns.anti_model_moodys: Issuer-pays ($4.1B ratings revenue). Measurement subject funding measurement = exact conflict CSOAI exists to negate.
validated_patterns.downdetector_ookla: $1.2B Accenture exit (Mar 2026). Existence proof that free-public-measurement + paid-enterprise-access is acquirable.
validated_patterns.l2beat: Refunded $1M angel round for neutrality. Path A archetype.
